  • Employment Contract: Cost 5

    {LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#Press}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#Click} to recruit a character. Select one from four 5-cost characters to obtain them. This item will disappear after use.

  • Privilege Weapon Box

    {LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#Press}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#Click} to open the Privilege Weapon Box and select one of four privileged equipment to obtain it. This item will disappear after use.

  • Employment Contract: Cost 4

    {LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#Press}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#Click} to recruit a character. Select one from four 4-cost characters to obtain them. This item will disappear after use.

  • Special Privilege Card

    Drag onto an advanced equipment to convert it into the corresponding privileged equipment. Drag onto a character to select one of their equipped advanced equipment to convert into privileged equipment. This item will disappear after use. "Card swap! Equipment evolution!"

  • Perfect Projector

    Drag onto any character to create a copy of that character with 1-star in the preparation area. This item will disappear after use. "HR's favorite tool. It has greatly eased the workforce shortage."

  • Good Fortune Token

    Drag onto a character to use. Select to gain one item from the four recommended advanced equipment for that character. This item will disappear after use.

  • Astropolis Privilege Card
  • Phantasmoon: Plot Armor

    Drag onto a character to use. You can select Plot Armor 1 time. This item disappears after use. "All eyes on me! I hereby declare: I'm the main character!"

  • Trailblaze: Perfect Projector

    Drag onto any "Trailblaze Silver Rail" character to use, creating a 1-star copy of this character in the preparation area. This item disappears after use.

  • Aha: Special Privilege Card

    Drag onto the Aha Indicator to use. Select one piece of Aha advanced equipment and convert it into the corresponding privileged equipment. This item disappears after use.

  • Trick Snack

    Drag onto the Beast Garden to use. Select 1 exclusive chimera for a character to increase its star rating by 1. This item disappears after use.

    {LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#Press}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#Click} to open an Aha Basic Weapon Box and select one of four pieces of Aha basic equipment to obtain. This item will disappear after use.

    Drag onto a character to remove all of their equipped gears. Can be used infinitely. While holding this item, obtaining another Disassembly Wrench will result in obtaining 1 Gold Coin instead. "Armed to the teeth? Let's pull those out too."
